note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 1 June 1933 in the Vow only. Thirteen divisions received nominations on Wednesday 10 May 1933 and nine none (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2); the sole nominees for Benvarden and Enagh withdrew (18 May 1933, p. 2). Ten sole nominees were returned unopposed; in the other eleven divisions the retiring members were deemed re-elected, but they are not named in the reports traced. Sole nominee, returned unopposed: the nominations (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2) list one candidate, and the withdrawals report (18 May 1933, p. 2) says the Vow was the only contest. Printed as a new candidate. Returned unopposed.
